brief: Navigates a nested list by paths: lists every location, finds an item wherever it hides, and reads the item at a path.
detail: A path is a list of 1-based positions that locates an item: [2,3,1] is the 1st item of the 3rd item of the 2nd item. stzDeepList is a stzList, so every list method is still there; this subclass adds the path vocabulary, and the recursive work runs in the Zig engine. Build one with new stzDeepList(aList) or DeepListQ(aList). The path utilities that do not need a list (IsSubPathOf, CommonPath, SortPaths) are globals in stzListPaths.ring.
